package design

import (
	"fmt"
	"os"
	"strconv"

	. "github.com/CaliLuke/loom/dsl"
	"github.com/CaliLuke/loom/expr"
)

func parameter(name string, fallback int) int {
	value := os.Getenv(name)
	if value == "" {
		return fallback
	}
	result, err := strconv.Atoi(value)
	if err != nil || result < 1 {
		panic("invalid scaling parameter: " + name)
	}
	return result
}

var methods = parameter("SCALING_METHODS", 4)
var width = parameter("SCALING_WIDTH", 16)
var unique = parameter("SCALING_TYPES", 1)
var recursive = os.Getenv("SCALING_RECURSIVE") == "1"
var declarations = make([]expr.UserType, unique)

var _ = API("scaling", func() {
	Server("scaling", func() {
		Services("scaling")
		Host("localhost", func() {
			URI("http://localhost:8080")
		})
	})
})

func init() {
	for index := range declarations {
		declarations[index] = Type(fmt.Sprintf("Record%d", index), func() {
			for field := range width {
				Attribute(fmt.Sprintf("field%d", field), String)
			}
			if recursive {
				Attribute("next", declarations[index])
			}
		})
	}
	Service("scaling", func() {
		for index := range methods {
			Method(fmt.Sprintf("method%d", index), func() {
				Payload(declarations[index%unique])
				Result(declarations[index%unique])
				HTTP(func() {
					POST(fmt.Sprintf("/method%d", index))
					Response(StatusOK)
				})
			})
		}
	})
}
